notes:
SUMMARY: High-priority prospect (national utilities operator). Strong mandate: on-prem, air-gapped inference for classified/unclassified separations. Team wants fully offline model hosting with signed daily update bundle process.

CONSTRAINTS / MANDATES: 
- No egress to public internet from the inference cluster.
- All images must be signed and verifiable (SBOM and supply-chain attestations).
- KMS must be FIPS 140-2 validated HSM or customer-managed key in physically separated HSM appliance.
- Audit trail + immutable logs retained for 7 years; export-only to approved SIEM via appliance.
- Must meet NIST SP 800-53 control baseline; FedRAMP discussion likely later.

RECENT QUOTES: 
- CISO: "We will not accept any runtime that requires outbound api calls. Offline patching and signed artifacts only."
- Head of ML Ops: "If you can prove local KV cache eviction consistency across upgrades, we'll sign off on POC."

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS: 
- Model packaging: offline tarball with signature, layered delta updates to reduce airgap patch window.
- Runtime: needs secure boot, verified kernel + deterministic container runtime (not just docker).
- Network: physically segmented VLAN with controlled jump-host for administrative tasks.
- Rollouts: canary on isolated slice, automatic rollback on divergence in latency/quality.
- Observability: local console + snapshot export, no telemetry to Redwood cloud without explicit signed consent for each release.

POC SCOPE REQUESTED: 
- 8-week air-gapped POC on 4xA100-equivalent nodes (customer will provide hardware spec).
- Evaluate chat + incident-triage workflow with 1000 QPS burst simulations and 50ms token-latency targets (tail SLOs are the focus).
- Validate image signing workflow and repeatable SBOM generation (third-party attestation).

PROCUREMENT NOTES:

- Procurement team will require three references with similar on-prem deliveries.
